evidence.note: What the pre-registered tests found for each rule behind the swing Ready list. Information only: no rule reads this file. Update it when a test is recorded in the Engine Rules; each line names the test.

india.label: Edge found in picking stocks
india.text: Stocks passing it beat those failing it by 1.19% a month, in 8 of 9 years (2011 to 2019).

us.label: Not confirmed
us.text: Passing stocks led by 0.24% a month, but the range includes zero. The US data has no delisted stocks, which hides losers.

india.label: No predictive value found
india.text: Green months did not come before better index returns than other months (2013 to 2019; 2006 to 2009 also not clear).

us.label: No predictive value found
us.text: Green months did not come before better index returns than other months (2018 to 2023).

india.label: No edge shown
india.text: The top four sectors did worse than the average sector (2013 to 2019), though not by a clear margin.

us.label: Worse than average
us.text: The top four sectors did clearly worse than the average sector (2018 to 2023).

india.label: No edge in judged tests
india.text: Only a few trades pass the gates, and they did not make money on average.

us.label: No edge in judged tests
us.text: No clear edge over the index in the judged window.

india.label: Not shown to help
india.text: They remove most trades, and the trades they removed did no worse than those they kept.

us.label: Not shown to help
us.text: Same finding: the removed trades did no worse than the kept ones.

rules.rule: Results-date gate (results more than 10 sessions away)

india.label: Not a return filter
india.text: Picks near results were not worse on average. The gate only narrows the spread of outcomes.

us.label: Not testable
us.text: No history of past US results dates is stored.

evidence.footer: These are the rules the list runs on. No test has shown that following the list earns more than holding the index. Nothing here places an order.
